newsitem.title: FINLAND: Valmet wins Korean paper machine order.
newsitem.headline: Valmet wins Korean paper machine order.

text.p: Finnish paper machine maker Valmet Oy said on Wednesday it won a complete paper machine order from South Korea's Yuhan-Kimberly Ltd for an undisclosed sum.
"The machine will produce 103 tonnes of bathroom tissue from virgin and recycled fibres," Valmet said in a statement.
The machine for Yuhan-Kimberly's Kimcheon mill expansion will be delivered in August 1997, and it is due to come on stream in spring 1998, Valmet said.
Valmet said this was its third such order from Korea and the seventh from Asia this year.
Yuhan-Kimberly has previously manufactured its own tissue machines, it said.
